1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one additional unique BMC polypeptide distinct from the at least one BMC polypeptide.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides, the plurality of different BMC polypeptides including at least two different BMC polypeptides.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides further comprises BMC polypeptides from distinct, non-overlapping bacterial species.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one additional unique BMC polypeptide distinct from the at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes the at least one BMC polypeptide and the at least one additional unique BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide and the at least one additional unique BMC polypeptide.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product, and at least one additional unique enzyme distinct from the at least one enzyme; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme and the at least one additional unique enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.
